title: Sheep wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='fluff' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d8d8ec'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <g stroke='none'>
    <!-- legs -->
    <rect x='34' y='76' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#3a2f4a'/>
    <rect x='58' y='76' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#3a2f4a'/>
    <rect x='33' y='89' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#241c33'/>
    <rect x='57' y='89' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#241c33'/>
    <!-- body fluff -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='url(#fluff)'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='54' r='11' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='54' r='11' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='78' r='10' fill='#f2f2fa'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='78' r='10' fill='#f2f2fa'/>
    <!-- head fluff -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='18' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='24' r='11' fill='#f6f6fc'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='11' fill='#f6f6fc'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='10' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <ellipse cx='29' cy='30' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#4b3f63'/>
    <ellipse cx='71' cy='30' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#4b3f63'/>
    <!-- face muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#f2e3d0'/>
    <!-- sunglasses -->
    <rect x='27' y='26' width='46' height='13' rx='5' fill='#1c1c2e'/>
    <rect x='29' y='28' width='19' height='9' rx='4' fill='#3fa9f5'/>
    <rect x='52' y='28' width='19' height='9' rx='4' fill='#3fa9f5'/>
    <rect x='31' y='29' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8e6ff'/>
    <rect x='54' y='29' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8e6ff'/>
    <rect x='47' y='29' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#1c1c2e'/>
    <rect x='26' y='27' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#1c1c2e'/>
    <rect x='70' y='27' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#1c1c2e'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e07a8a'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M44 46 Q50 51 56 46' stroke='#c9b8a6' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
